_comment: Hetzner Object Storage nbg1, bucket qbucket-it-lock: created 2026-10-20 with object lock (rclone --s3-bucket-object-lock-enabled), so versioning is on as well; holds a guard object. Legal hold and retention probe as supported (404 ObjectLockConfigurationNotFoundError on an object without either).
_objectWrites: Verified 2026-10-21 (nbg1): tag and ACL writes leave the object intact (canary + victim ITs). A copy to another key keeps the tags; a copy onto itself with REPLACE drops them; sending them along with x-amz-tagging (directive REPLACE) leaves them unreadable (GET ?tagging answers 200 with an empty body, HEAD reports 0) — PutObjectTagging afterwards restores them.
_headReportsDeleteMarker: Like Ceph (RGW): HEAD / GET on a deleted key answer a bare 404 without x-amz-delete-marker; CopyObject from a version sends neither x-amz-copy-source-version-id nor x-amz-version-id. Verified 2026-10-21.
